review.notes: Reviewed every take by contact strip. Idle and flight were retaken with steady light and a steady bell glow because the first takes blacked out the plate repeatedly; the flight loop thins the held wing poses between strokes so the wingbeat keeps moving. The first attack turned the manta into a sleek wingless fish shape mid-dive, so it is retaken keeping both wings and the bells. The hit is retaken with room below because the first take cut the wing tip at the bottom edge. Ranged, defend, cast and death are first takes.
